name: turn-timestamp
description: Shows the date and time of every completed answer so you can tell how fresh a tab is.

display.title: Where to show the stamp
display.description: auto draws a line beneath each answer (terminal, VS Code) and a band above the prompt with the latest stamp (terminal, desktop Code tab). answer, band, status and log each pick one channel; status pins a plugin status line, which the desktop folds into a collapsed notice.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: An IANA zone such as America/New_York. Empty uses the machine's zone, or TZ when set.
